capabilities: Download CSS snippets from a GitHub repository
List downloaded snippets in plugin settings
disambiguation: It does not apply or edit snippet code itself; activation still happens in Obsidian's Appearance settings.
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README is brief and points contributors to the snippet repository.
motivation: The author was tired of installing CSS snippets manually and wanted an easier way.
problem: Obsidian users must manually download and place CSS snippet files into their vault to use custom themes and snippets.

relations.evidence: Available snippets are being pulled from opa-oz/obsidian-snippets.

summary: Snippet downloader that pulls CSS snippets from a GitHub repository into the vault and lists them for activation in Appearance settings.
